name: year
description: Reference year of the observation

name: area_fips
description: County FIPS code (5-digit)

name: own_code
description: Ownership code identifying the sector (private, federal, state, local government)

name: industry_code
description: Industry code (NAICS, supersector, or aggregate pseudo-code)
observations: Real NAICS codes align with br_bd_diretorios_us.naics_2022; aggregate and supersector codes are QCEW-specific

name: agglvl_code
description: Aggregation-level code indicating the geographic and industry summarization of the row

name: size_code
description: Establishment size-class code, 0 for all sizes

name: disclosure_code
description: Disclosure flag: N when the figure is not disclosable, blank otherwise

name: annual_avg_estabs
description: Annual average of quarterly establishment counts

name: annual_avg_emplvl
description: Annual average of monthly employment levels

name: total_annual_wages
description: Sum of the four quarters' total wages for the year

name: taxable_annual_wages
description: Sum of the four quarters' taxable wages for the year

name: annual_contributions
description: Sum of the four quarters' unemployment-insurance contributions for the year

name: annual_avg_wkly_wage
description: Average weekly wage based on the year's employment and total wages

name: avg_annual_pay
description: Average annual pay based on the year's employment and wage levels

name: lq_disclosure_code
description: Disclosure flag for the location quotient: N when not disclosable, blank otherwise

name: lq_annual_avg_estabs
description: Location quotient of the annual average establishment count relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_annual_avg_emplvl
description: Location quotient of annual average employment relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_total_annual_wages
description: Location quotient of total annual wages relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_taxable_annual_wages
description: Location quotient of taxable annual wages relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_annual_contributions
description: Location quotient of annual contributions relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_annual_avg_wkly_wage
description: Location quotient of the annual average weekly wage relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: lq_avg_annual_pay
description: Location quotient of average annual pay relative to the U.S., rounded to hundredths

name: oty_disclosure_code
description: Disclosure flag for the over-the-year change: N when not disclosable, blank otherwise

name: oty_annual_avg_estabs_chg
description: Over-the-year change in the annual average establishment count

name: oty_annual_avg_estabs_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in the annual average establishment count, rounded to tenths

name: oty_annual_avg_emplvl_chg
description: Over-the-year change in annual average employment

name: oty_annual_avg_emplvl_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in annual average employment, rounded to tenths

name: oty_total_annual_wages_chg
description: Over-the-year change in total annual wages

name: oty_total_annual_wages_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in total annual wages, rounded to tenths

name: oty_taxable_annual_wages_chg
description: Over-the-year change in taxable annual wages

name: oty_taxable_annual_wages_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in taxable annual wages, rounded to tenths

name: oty_annual_contributions_chg
description: Over-the-year change in annual contributions

name: oty_annual_contributions_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in annual contributions, rounded to tenths

name: oty_annual_avg_wkly_wage_chg
description: Over-the-year change in the annual average weekly wage

name: oty_annual_avg_wkly_wage_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in the annual average weekly wage, rounded to tenths

name: oty_avg_annual_pay_chg
description: Over-the-year change in average annual pay

name: oty_avg_annual_pay_pct_chg
description: Over-the-year percent change in average annual pay, rounded to tenths
